sourceMethod: Independent web rendering of direct official Qavanin text, metadata and status-index pages. The rendering exposed document text and line-addressable page content, but raw HTTP response bytes were not captured and no source SHA-256 was computed.

consolidatedLaw.title: قانون صدور چک
consolidatedLaw.note: The consolidated page currently renders Article 7 with an amendment label dated 1403/03/30 and the listed monetary thresholds. The original law's Gazette and effective dates belong only to the 1355 enactment; they do not prove the publication, commencement or temporal application of the 1403 adjustment. The current consolidated rendering is not an approved event-date version.
